intent: Investigate reported 'looping' in Hermes' recent sessions, fix the root cause, and add rules to stop it recurring.
summary: Traced two problems in Hermes' PSI-081/PSI-082 sessions: (1) it ran `git checkout <branch>` directly in the one shared main working directory, sometimes while docs/list-task-project.md/obsidian-out were uncommitted, then re-ran obsidian-sync on the new branch, producing near-duplicate handoff/'update workspace.json' commits and two nearly identical blocked write-ups on PSI-082 seventeen minutes apart; (2) PSI-081 was built, merged and frozen `blocked` (missing .env.local Supabase keys), then a later session re-implemented it from scratch against the same unmet precondition instead of escalating, landing at `outcome: partial` on the identical blocker. Separately found `obsidian-out/.obsidian/plugins/` and five per-user Obsidian app-state files tracked in git despite an existing (non-retroactive) .gitignore rule; none of it is written by scripts/obsidian-sync.ts, and the `remotely-save` plugin's own data.json explicitly warns it holds an encrypted remote-storage credential blob, a live secret-leak risk. Fixed: git rm --cached the app-state files and plugins/, extended .gitignore, added three coordination rules to docs/agent-operations/README.md (never switch branches in a dirty shared folder — use a second worktree; escalate rather than retry an already-hit blocker; never commit Obsidian's own app state). Also found and merged master into task/PSI-066 so its own history stopped reintroducing the untracked paths, without touching Hermes' in-progress uncommitted work. This entry itself is a retroactive record: the PR #46 session ended without one, which this fixes (C-14).

changes.note: git rm --cached; vendored plugin bundles, never generated by our tooling
3 new coordination rules against the branch-switch/retry loop and committing Obsidian app state
Merged origin/master in so PR #45's own history stops reintroducing the untracked paths; Hermes' uncommitted work restored untouched

decisions.decision: Fix by removing tracking + gitignore + rules, not by rewriting any branch's history
decisions.reason: task/PSI-066 was an active branch with another agent's uncommitted work in the shared folder; rewriting history there is forbidden (never rebase/force-push someone else's branch)
alternatives: git filter-repo to scrub history entirely (unnecessary: the sensitive file was never actually committed)

verification.manual: bun scripts/obsidian-sync.ts and bun run agent:check run clean after the .gitignore/tracking change; PR #45 (task/PSI-066) confirmed MERGEABLE/CLEAN after the merge-in.

follow_ups.note: Kanban task detail panel (click to open, linked calendar + finance), added in the next session
